mainEntity.name: What type of insulation works best for a barndominium?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spray foam insulation is generally the most effective choice for a metal-framed barndominium. Metal panels transfer heat rapidly, making thermal bridging and condensation significant concerns during hot summers and cold desert nights. Closed-cell spray foam seals directly to the metal exterior, creating a continuous vapor barrier that prevents moisture buildup and air leaks. Traditional fiberglass batts are cheaper upfront, but they can sag, leave gaps against steel framing, and trap moisture if a vapor barrier fails.
acceptedAnswer.description: Closed-cell spray foam insulation is best. It adheres directly to metal panels, creating an airtight thermal envelope and vapor barrier that prevents condensation and thermal bridging.
